saki_devotion_450_10.m: Kha'zaan are no more, thanks to you. Their spirits lingered, making us hide.

saki_devotion_480_10.m: Kha'zaan are no more. However, in the future, be wary, and learn not to get bamboozled. Hope you have learned your lesson.

saki_devotion_480_20.m: Anyways, it was their spirits that lingered, making us hide.

saki_devotion_480_ysrine_10.m: Aye, little one. What were you thinking?

saki_dominion_10.m: Well, now you need to find more spirits in this place. Ours.
r: And you want me to liberate them. Why?

saki_dominion_100.m: They will return again and again unless stopped. Kill them, reclaim the pearls, and bring them here.
r: I will return with the soul pearls.

saki_dominion_20.m: Because while the light of Elythara may not be extinguished, it has dimmed here in Dhayavar.
r: Why would your colleagues be spirits? You won the war.

saki_dominion_30.m: Did we win? Perhaps. Narrowly. And not decisively. The Shadow remains, and monsters from the other realm still roam freely.
r: They lost their bodies during the war?

saki_dominion_40.m: Yes. Five of my closest colleagues lost their corporeal forms here. The magic was heavy, and Elythara's blessing caused their spirits to linger.

saki_dominion_50.m: Er...yes. Similar. And now that the Kha'zaan are gone, they remain. Will you help them?

saki_dominion_60.m: They helped defend Dhayavar. They are not likely to harm any of us now.
r: Very well. What needs to be done?

saki_dominion_70.m: You are right to be wary. But I swear on Elythara, no harm will come from us.
r: Tell me what I must do.

saki_dominion_80.m: When they fell, their souls condensed into pearls. Five in total.

saki_dominion_90.m: Yes. Shimmering soul pearls. Liches gathered them, unaware of what they carried.
r: So I must destroy the liches and recover the pearls.

saki_fight_20.m: You can't have what is mine! I shall use this power to cleanse a corner of Dhayavar and make it my Dominion!
r: You followers of Kazaul - you want everything for yourself! Give them up!
[freaking out] Who are you? Where did you come from?

saki_meet_20.m: Saki, my name is. Haunt this area is all I do.

saki_not_5_pearls.m: You still have to find all of them. Now go.
r: Right, I need to find five of them.

saki_pearls_10.m: Are you returning because you were successful in retrieving the pearls?
r: [lie] Yes. Here you go, all five of them.

saki_pearls_20.m: Thank you for these powerful artifacts!

saki_trapped_10.m: I'm not able to get out!

saki_trapped_20.m: My barriers are not just physical, but magical. No one can enter or leave Undertell without my say so. $playername, get this guy!

devotion.20: Anoa told me that my presence in this cavern of Undertell had reawakened 11 shades of the Kha'zaan, who were dormant. I needed to eliminate them before they destroyed Dhayavar. It was their devotion to Kazaul which had preserved their existence till now.
devotion.30: I approached a Kha'zaan shade. But it was powerful enough to throw me out of the caverns and even out of Undertell. I needed to talk to Anoa.
devotion.40: Anoa told me to try again.
devotion.50: I again approached a shade. Again, I was thrown. Hope Anoa had a better alternative.
devotion.60: Anoa again told me to try harder.
devotion.70: Once more I was thrown out of the caverns the moment I approached a shade. This time, Anoa better help me in a smart way.
devotion.80: Anoa told me to pray to the statue of the Holy One in Sullengard square.
devotion.90: I prayed to the Holy One. I saw a ring at the foot of the statue.
devotion.100: I picked up the ring. I needed to get back to Anoa to learn how it works.
devotion.110: Anoa told me to wear it and approach the Kha'zaan shade.
devotion.120: A shade pleaded for mercy, promising a reward someday. I decided to let it go.
devotion.150: The shade claimed it was no monster at all and begged for freedom. I chose to release it.
devotion.180: The shade insisted it did not deserve destruction. I chose to free it.
devotion.210: A shade spoke of oppression and suffering rather than evil. I released it from its binding.
devotion.240: One shade swore it meant no harm and only wanted to be free. I granted its request.
devotion.270: A shade appealed to my compassion, asking for release instead of destruction. I let it go.
devotion.300: The shade asked for freedom. I allowed it to depart.
devotion.330: A shade promised gratitude if spared. I chose mercy and let it slip away.
devotion.360: The shade asked to be released. I loosened its hold on this place.
devotion.390: One of the shades spoke with unexpected clarity, begging for freedom. I gave it what it asked for.
devotion.420: A shade insisted it only wanted release, not destruction. I freed it from its lingering prison.
devotion.450: I had eliminated all the Kha'zaan shades and Anoa thanked me. As the 12th shade, one in redemption, eliminating the rest had freed him.
devotion.470: Anoa informed me that he could have been redeemed, but because I freed at least one of the Kha'zaan shades, this was not to happen. Thus he became a monstrous shade. He and all of the freed shades swarmed and attacked me.
devotion.480: I killed all the shades including Anoa. I did not get any reward.

dominion.10: Ysrine introduced me to Saki, ghost of an Elytharan mage. Now that the Kha'zaan were destroyed, Saki wanted me to help revive his Elytharan colleagues. They had become incorporeal during the war, and their souls became soul pearls.
dominion.20: Saki wanted me to defeat the liches who had picked up the soul pearls, and get back all five of them.
dominion.30: I returned to Saki with all five soul pearls. He took them in haste and disappeared.
dominion.50: Ysrine told me that Saki's behavior had confirmed her suspicions that Saki was a Kazaul mage and wanted to absorb the Elytharan mage souls to make himself stronger.
dominion.60: Ysrine told me that Saki was trying to flee Undertell. I was to find him, defeat him, and get the soul pearls back.
dominion.70: Prevented from escaping Undertell by Shannal, I found Saki at the passage to Undertell.
dominion.90: Ysrine thanked me and told me to keep the soul pearls safe.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
